We have Alexandra Park's virtual onsite penciled for Tuesday 16 Jul (candidate prefers US-PST morning). Because we have constrained interviewer availability, I'm proposing a "zippering" plan (two parallel mini-tracks that stagger by 15 minutes) so we can:

- keep total candidate time to ~4 hours
- run two interview panels in parallel for different competencies (systems + product)
- enable 15-min rapid debriefs immediately after each panel to capture impressions while fresh

- Track A (Panel 1): 9:00–10:30 PST — Systems deep dive (three 30-min blocks + 5-min buffer)
- Track B (Panel 2): 9:15–10:45 PST — Product & design (three 30-min blocks + 5-min buffer)
- 10:45–11:00 PST — 15-min rapid debrief (Panel 2)
- 10:50–11:05 PST — 15-min rapid debrief (Panel 1)
- Final hiring-committee sync: 11:20–11:40 PST (synchronous)

Asks:
1) Jonas / Marissa — can you each own one rapid debrief slot (15 min) and be the single-source scribe for that panel?
2) Laura — can you confirm availability for the hiring-committee sync at 11:20 PST?
3) Samantha / Alex — Alexandra, can you confirm the 9:00–1:00 PST window? If the candidate needs an earlier start, we can shift everything earlier.

Attachments: Alexandra_Park_Resume.pdf, zipper_slot_matrix_v2.xlsx

I want to keep the day tight so evaluators can submit quick scores and we can move fast on a hire if the loop goes well. Ping me with any hard conflicts today and I'll iterate.
